description: Shared GitLab MCP HTTP endpoints for the Juno SDLC platform (no secrets). AgentCore gitlab-agent and qa-agent publish must use directMcpUrl to bypass CloudFront WAF.

waf.symptom: 403 on POST /mcp when publish payloads contain patterns like http://localhost
waf.mitigation: Set GITLAB_MCP_HTTP_DIRECT_URL to directMcpUrl on gitlab_agent and qa_agent AgentCore runtimes

runtimeEnv.GITLAB_MCP_URL: Optional; keep cloudFront.mcpUrl for IDE. gitlab_mcp_client prefers GITLAB_MCP_HTTP_DIRECT_URL.
